verdict.rationale: AnyDesk's own docs say its CLI can be used with software deployment tools to install and configure AnyDesk on multiple devices without per-machine setup. Its REST API and open-source Python module can list all registered clients and export session data to CSV. However, the fan-out across many machines relies on external deployment tools, and the API operations shown act on one item at a time (change an alias, remove a client, close a session). missing for 10: a native bulk-action endpoint or console feature that acts on many items in one call, bulk write operations through the API, an OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: You can use CLI commands with software deployment tools to install and configure AnyDesk on multiple devices, without manual setup on each machine.
List all AnyDesk clients registered to the account
Export session data (to terminal or CSV)
